_about: 2-Propanol (1) + Furfuryl alcohol (2): total pressures against temperature, 353.2-408.2 K, at set liquid compositions. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 2-propanol, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record.

source.citation: W. P. Tai, H. Y. Lee, M. J. Lee, Isothermal vapor liquid equilibrium for binary mixtures containing furfural and its derivatives, Fluid Phase Equilib. 384 (2014) 134-142
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 8. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. No isotherm of the set has its own pure-component pressures, so the fit uses the vapour pressures of the component records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
